summary: Compared all six published P21 F1 qPCR measurements with the registered EDC-versus-vehicle RNA-seq effects. Four genes decreased in both assays. Drd1 and Crh had opposite signs. The proposal passed validation and requests no full-verification sign-off.
openIssues: The public-source search located no gene-level author RNA-seq table for the F1 contrast. Genome-wide effects, P values and FDR remain unassessed.
The qPCR panel falls below the 30-pair concordance minimum. Animal overlap between assays and the RNA library-to-litter mapping remain unknown.
